colorSpace: baseColor values are linear RGB (glTF baseColorFactor)

basisKinds.owner-photo: finish seen in the owner's private reference photographs; only the finish was taken, never pixels
basisKinds.v40-text: stated in the locked V40 assembly manual text
basisKinds.v40-illustration: colour of the part in the V40 manual illustration
basisKinds.assumption: presentation choice; the real finish is not established

nylon-black.label: Black nylon
nylon-black.note: V40 step 1 names the standoffs nylon; screw and rivet finish are assumed to match

connector-cream.label: Cream connector plastic
connector-cream.note: the owner photo shows a cream JST housing on the ultrasonic module; HAT housings are assumed to match

contact-gold.label: Gold-plated contacts
contact-gold.note: header pins and mounting pads; the plating is not measured

usb3-blue.label: USB 3.0 tongue plastic
usb3-blue.note: USB 3.0 receptacles conventionally use blue tongues

proxy-satin-grey.label: Fused proxy (single solid, several real finishes)
proxy-satin-grey.note: the ultrasonic proxy fuses board and transducer cans into one solid, so one neutral finish is used rather than inventing a split

pcb-white.label: White solder mask
pcb-white.note: the owner's Robot HAT V4 is white on both faces

fr4-edge.label: FR4 board edge
fr4-edge.note: the tan glass-epoxy core shows at the HAT's edges and bores

header-yellow.label: Yellow header plastic
header-yellow.note: servo signal row; albedo from the owner's top photograph against the white mask at 0.80

header-red.label: Red header plastic
header-red.note: servo 5V row; albedo from the owner's top photograph against the white mask at 0.80

connector-white.label: White connector plastic
connector-white.note: JST XH housings, switch bases, LED bodies and the speaker plug; a warm off-white, set by eye because the housing tops sit in shade in the photographs

mlcc-tan.label: Ceramic capacitor body
mlcc-tan.note: albedo from the owner's top photograph against the white mask at 0.80

ferrite-grey.label: Shielded inductor body
ferrite-grey.note: albedo from the owner's top photograph against the white mask at 0.80

tact-tan.label: Beige button actuator
tact-tan.note: albedo from the owner's top photograph against the white mask at 0.80

speaker-felt.label: Speaker diaphragm felt
speaker-felt.note: albedo from the owner's top photograph against the white mask at 0.80

shell-dark.label: Dark USB-C shell
shell-dark.note: the owner's charging receptacle reads as dark metal in every frame; a neutral dark metal, since the photographed colour is a reflection of the room

regions.rule: A definition's solids take materials by solid index in BRep order. byDefinition wins over byKind; its list length must equal the definition's solid count.
